# gitea_repos (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enumerate every repo owned by an organization and emit their full names.
# Pair this with `for_each` to apply branch-protection (or any per-repo
# resource) across the whole org without hardcoding the repo list.

data "gitea_repos" "org_repos" {
  owner    = "my-org"
  archived = "false"
}

output "org_repo_full_names" {
  value = data.gitea_repos.org_repos.full_names
}

# Apply baseline branch protection to every non-archived repo in the org.
resource "gitea_repository_branch_protection" "baseline" {
  for_each = {
    for r in data.gitea_repos.org_repos.repos : r.full_name => r
  }

  username  = each.value.owner
  name      = each.value.name
  rule_name = each.value.default_branch
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (String) Filter by archived state: 'true' (archived only), 'false' (active only), or 'all' (default).
- `exclude_template` (Boolean) When true, template repositories are excluded from results.
- `keyword_in_description` (Boolean) Also match 'query' against repository descriptions, not just names.
- `keyword_is_topic` (Boolean) Treat 'query' as a topic name rather than a free-text keyword.
- `owner` (String) Restrict results to repositories owned by this user or organization.
- `page_size` (Number) Page size for the underlying SearchRepos API. Pagination is handled internally.
- `private` (String) Filter by visibility: 'true' (private only), 'false' (public only), or 'all' (default).
- `query` (String) Free-text keyword to match against repository name (and description when keyword_in_description is set).
- `type` (String) Restrict results to a repo type: '' (any), 'source', 'fork', or 'mirror'.

### Read-Only

- `full_names` (List of String) Convenience flat list of full_name values, in the same order as 'repos'.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `repos` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repos))
